summary: The team reviewed API latency, noting it is 300 ms versus a target under 200 ms, and decided to keep the current database schema. They planned a CI pipeline deployment by Friday, assigned documentation updates, and scheduled benchmark sharing by Priya on Monday, while mentioning future load testing and continued model training.

minutes.discussion: Latency is about 300 milliseconds, target is under 200 milliseconds.
A suggestion to move to Redis caching was raised but no decision was made.
The team agreed to keep the current schema and not change it this sprint.
The new CI pipeline will be deployed by Friday.
Load testing was mentioned as a future consideration.
The model needs three more days of training before moving to Kubernetes.
Priya will share benchmark results with the team on Monday.
